title: Pronuclear transfer in normally fertilised human embryos
protocol: Equilibrate 5 ml G-TL in a 5 ml tube at 37°C, 6% CO2, and 5% O2.
Equilibrate another 5 ml Embryo Biopsy Medium in a 5 ml tube at 37°C, 6% CO2, and 5% O2.
Equilibrate two 4 ml aliquots of Ovoil in 5 ml tubes at 37°C, 6% CO2, and 5% O2.
Setup G-TL culture dishes for post-manipulation zygotes.
Make two 100 µl drops of G-TL in a center-well dish.
Overlay the G-TL drops with 1.5 ml Ovoil.
Setup a G-TL wash dish for washing manipulated zygotes prior to transfer.
Add 0.5 ml G-TL to a center well dish.
Cover the G-TL in the wash dish with 1.5 ml Ovoil.
Conduct all zygote manipulations in an environmentally controlled isolator set at 37°C, 6% CO2, and 5% O2.
Switch on the heated stage of the Integra Ti micromanipulator to 37°C.
Set up the Integra Ti micromanipulator system with holding and biopsy pipettes as per manufacturer’s instructions.
Calibrate the laser according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Setup a manipulation pipette immersion dish for keeping holding and biopsy pipettes immersed in medium between manipulations.
Add five 5 µl drops of equilibrated G-TL into an ICSI dish.
Pour over equilibrated Ovoil.
Setup the PNT manipulation ICSI dish with two 5µl drops of equilibrated Embryo Biopsy Medium containing 10µg/ml Nocodazole and 2.5µm Latrunculin A.
Add one 2µl drop of HVJ-E to the dish.
Cover the drops with equilibrated Ovoil.
Prime the holding and biopsy pipettes in the manipulation pipette immersion dish.
Transfer two zygotes into separate drops of Nocodazole/Latrunculin A containing medium.
Replace the pipette immersion dish with the manipulation dish.
Position the first zygote so that both pronuclei are in focus, ensuring polar bodies are distant from the biopsy site.
Immobilize the zygote by gentle suction with the holding pipette.
Select the laser objective and ensure the pronuclei are in focus.
Using a 6.7µm, 0.251ms, 400mw setting for the Saturn laser, create an opening in the zona pellucida by making holes from inside outwards to reduce risk of damage upon zygote breach.
Ensure the first pronucleus and biopsy pipette are in focus.
Insert the biopsy pipette into the embryo, positioning it so there is minimal cytoplasm between the pronucleus and the opening.
Gently aspirate the first pronucleus into the biopsy pipette.
Continue to aspirate but start to remove the biopsy pipette once the pronucleus has entered the pipette.
Pulling the biopsy pipette away from the zygote will separate the first karyoplast.
Expel the karyoplast out of the pipette.
Repeat the process to remove the second pronucleus.
Release the zygote from the holding pipette.
Aspirate the karyoplasts from the second zygote into the biopsy pipette.
Lift the holding pipette out of the dish.
Move the biopsy pipette to the drop of HVJ-E.
Gently start to expel the karyoplast but stop when a karyoplast reaches the opening of the pipette.
Aspirate a minimal amount of HVJ-E to ensure the karyoplast is just inside the pipette.
Move the biopsy pipette to the drop with the first enucleated zygote.
Position the enucleated zygote with the hole in the zona at the 3 o'clock position.
Immobilize the zygote by gentle suction with the holding pipette.
Insert the pipette to ensure good contact with the cytoplast.
Expel the karyoplasts slowly at the same time as gently removing the pipette.
Pinch off excess cytoplasm between the biopsy pipette and zona pellucida.
Aspirate karyoplasts from the first zygote into the biopsy pipette.
Repeat steps 17 to 25, moving to the drop with the second enucleated zygote at step 20.
Replace the manipulation dish with the pipette immersion dish if more manipulations are needed.
Transfer one reconstituted zygote to the G-TL wash dish.
Wash gently around the drop in the G-TL wash dish.
Transfer the zygote to a G-TL culture dish for post-manipulation zygotes, clearly labeling with embryo details.
Repeat steps 29 to 30.
Culture the zygotes at 37°C, 6% CO2 and 5% O2 in the isolator-based workstation incubator.
